title: African SME opportunity search
description: Describe the business you are helping. Standard extraction needs no API key. Optional AI matching uses your own OpenAI key and is billed separately.

query.title: What opportunity do you need?
query.description: Natural-language need, for example opportunities for women-owned fashion businesses. Never used as a CSS selector or raw crawl URL.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: MVP sources currently cover Nigeria, Ghana and Kenya, plus Africa-wide programmes. Do not treat this as full continental coverage.

opportunityTypes.title: Opportunity types
opportunityTypes.description: Leave empty to keep every matching type from the selected sources.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: How many valid opportunities to save. Default 20. Hard cap 50. You pay per saved dataset item.

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Optional sector hints such as fashion, agriculture or green.

targetGroups.title: Target groups
targetGroups.description: Optional. Keep programmes aimed at groups such as women-owned, youth-owned or green businesses.

businessStages.title: Business stages
businessStages.description: Optional. idea, early-stage, growth or export-ready.

includeExpired.title: Include expired opportunities
includeExpired.description: Keep programmes whose published deadline has already passed.

closingWithinDays.title: Closing within days
closingWithinDays.description: Optional. Only keep opportunities with a deadline inside this many days.

requireDeadline.title: Require a deadline
requireDeadline.description: If enabled, drop opportunities that do not publish a deadline.

requireApplicationUrl.title: Require an application URL
requireApplicationUrl.description: If enabled, drop opportunities that do not include an application link.

ai.title: AI Opportunity Agent
ai.description: Optional. Standard extraction works with AI off. When enabled, you supply your own OpenAI key. Scouvela charges only for successful AI events; OpenAI bills you separately.
ai.sectionDescription: Bring your own OpenAI key. The key is never written to the Dataset, logs, or Actor output.

enabled.title: Enable AI matching
enabled.description: Plans the search, summarises each saved opportunity, and optionally writes a brief. Failed AI calls are not charged.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Only OpenAI is supported in this version. You pay that provider directly.

generateReport.title: Generate an opportunity brief
generateReport.description: Writes OPPORTUNITY_REPORT to the key-value store. Charged as ai-opportunity-report only when the brief is saved.

openaiApiKey.title: OpenAI API key
openaiApiKey.description: Required only when AI matching is on. Stored as an Apify secret. Never logged or saved on records. You pay OpenAI directly.

sourceTypes.title: Discovery sources
sourceTypes.description: Curated websites stay on by default. Add submitted public webpages or public Instagram pages when you want Scouvela to read those URLs itself.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional public webpage or Instagram URLs. Maximum 20. HTTP and HTTPS only. Localhost, private-network addresses, and embedded credentials are rejected. URLs are not used as code or selectors.

discoverFromProfiles.title: Read recent public profile posts
discoverFromProfiles.description: When enabled, Scouvela may inspect a limited number of recent publicly visible posts from a submitted supported profile.

maxPostsPerProfile.title: Maximum posts per profile
maxPostsPerProfile.description: Used only when reading recent public profile posts is enabled. Minimum 1, maximum 10.
